description: Per-NDC NADAC fact at the latest held generation: verbatim published fields (ndc_description, nadac_per_unit, pricing_unit, effective_date, classification, corresponding-generic pair), the computed corresponding-generic gap, and long-horizon changes (~1 week / ~1 month / ~6 months / 12 months, honest nulls). NADAC is a national average pharmacy acquisition benchmark published by CMS — not a consumer figure; every response carries the label sentence. Structured input only. Free pre-check at POST /toll/nadac/fact/preflight. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/nadac/fact.
name: nadac_fact
